answer: All three, in this order of value: a model of the work (projects, roles, state), the capability surface (labels, wait, tail, history, ended/exit_code), and honest rendering (VT preview). Rendering alone is the brutalist CLI we already have.
body: 'Pissweak fidelity' needs a referent. (a) To zmx's capability surface: a thin wrapper ignores labels, wait, tail, history, print-env. (b) To a model of the work: projects, groups, roles, session state, readiness. (c) To the terminal itself: truthful VT scrollback rendering. The three lead to different products; naming the referent is the first real decision.
title: Fidelity to what?
